title: US Workers Secretly Take ‘Workations’
summary: Америкт ажилчид даргадаа хэлэлгүй амралтын газраас ажилладаг болсон тухай.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Dora Mekouar, Anna Matteo · VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: Dora Mekouar reported this story for VOA News. Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.

changes: Program intro and outro, sign-off, credit line and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.explain: "This is when employees work remotely from a vacation place without telling their boss" гэж тайлбарласан.

questions.prompt: What do some hotels offer to remote workers?
options: Lower room prices and extra services
Part-time jobs working at the hotel
questions.explain: Жишээ нь Gray Havens Inn "25 percent off the room rate" болон өглөөний цай, бэлэг санал болгодог.

questions.prompt: What does Rudi Riekstins think about workations?
options: They can be good for workers and companies
They should always be kept secret from the boss
They make workers less creative at work
questions.explain: Тэр "workations can be good for both workers and employers" гэж хэлсэн. Аз жаргалтай ажилчид илүү бүтээлч байдаг гэнэ.
